name: Your other shadow
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Art-direct ONE singular unforgettable website hero for Perry, the ink stickman companion for a Mac. Finished desktop screenshot 1536x1024 landscape. User loves monumental living-ink typography, visual wit and a useful interaction, hates conventional SaaS layouts and cute paper props. Create a sharply authored brand image with ONE optical surprise.
CONCEPT YOUR OTHER SHADOW. A computer cursor casts a shadow that has a mind of its own. On an almost-white smooth paper canvas, one immense BLACK cursor arrow silhouette lies at a diagonal across the upper-right two-thirds, tip at x1000 y150, tail near x1250 y460. It is sharp, matte screenprinted ink, subtly lifted only enough to justify a shadow, NOT a glossy plastic or 3D emoji. Its exaggerated long shadow falls diagonally down-left, BUT the shadow has the unmistakable shape of Perry: a circular oversized head with TWO little white oval eyes and NO mouth, thin stick limbs, one arm reaching forward. Crucially the shadow starts as the cursor's exact shape at its foot and smoothly stretches into the character through one long graceful ink connection; it is ONE coherent figure-ground illusion, not a separate cartoon pasted next to an arrow. Perry's shadow hand reaches toward a tiny ordinary CORAL visitor cursor at lower-left. Body language eager and helpful. The shadow should be elegantly elongated, graphic and weightless, not sinister, realistic-human, horror or a huge black blob. His other arm is planted on the page as he leans out of the expected shadow direction. One almost invisible pencil outline indicates where the normal arrow-shaped shadow should have been, allowing the visitor to discover the joke.
Oversized expressive custom black brush script across left upper area exactly 'oh,\ncompany.' The handwritten o's are open and letters superb, airy asymmetrical composition. The script and cursor-shadow meet in the centre through precise overlaps, maintaining readability. No stock text column beside hero image. Only ONE small handwritten aside near the shadow's reaching hand: 'right here.'
Tiny lowercase handwritten 'perry' at top-left; top-right simple 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' and sun/moon control. Bottom left clean 27px sans promise 'A little company for every click.' Below 18px 'Perry sees your screen, helps you learn, and takes on tasks.' Bottom right CORAL action button with BLACK text 'Meet your other shadow ↗', subtle 'Try a website demo'. Keep the CTA away from the shadow's hand, clear and useful. Ivory/black/coral only, minimal paper grain, immense scale contrast, extraordinary negative space, optimistic and playful. NO windows, screenshots, panels, cards, feature grid, chrome, photoreal objects, pop-up notebook, ruled paper, gradient or robot. Design must read as a world-class visual identity and an inviting interactive encounter. The shadow is the character, not a cast shadow behind an ordinary visible mascot.

name: The question that gets up
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. A finished original desktop website hero for Perry, a Mac assistant with a dry-ink stickman mascot. 1536x1024 landscape, full viewport. Design an iconic visual device with excellent composition, functional product promise and invitation. No SaaS templates.
CONCEPT THE QUESTION THAT GETS UP. A monumental expressive BLACK question mark occupies the left/center 70 percent of a vivid clean pale mint-green canvas. The question mark's main curved stroke is a gorgeously drawn thick ink path like a single large sculptural brush gesture, open loop, dry edges, continuous confident shape. The DOT underneath has COME ALIVE: it is actually Perry's oversized round unfilled head, with exactly TWO black vertical oval eyes and NO mouth. Beneath this head a tiny black stick body with two arms and two legs has unfolded, so the 'dot' is standing up and walking right. He is holding the loose end of the huge question-mark stroke with one hand and pulling it with him; its lower end bends downward and becomes a long elegant underline, suggesting confusion straightening into help. He must still visually occupy the dot's natural position beneath the question mark so the viewer first sees punctuation, then notices a person. This double reading is the entire design. Character about 170px total height, head approximately 80px, pose playful, never babyish. One tiny normal-size coral computer cursor hovers at his free hand. No second mascot.
Across the right open portion, enormous sophisticated black condensed sans text exactly 'Ask away.' at 120px, tucked against the question curve so typography and mark share a single dramatic graphic composition. Below it, a small real selectable prompt on the canvas (not a card) reads 'Where do I click?' with a coral hand-drawn underline and small arrow. Its placement invites asking the character. One understated label above the prompt: 'Try asking Perry'. Clean 22px supporting line toward bottom-left: 'Help with what’s on your Mac. Right when you need it.' Additional 18px exact line 'Ask, follow a guide, or let Perry take over the task.'
Small hand-lettered 'perry' upper-left. Top-right 'Get Perry for Mac ↗', theme control. Bottom right one BLACK filled CTA with mint-white text 'Ask Perry ↗'. Use pale fresh mint #DFF7E7-like background, saturated coral only for the small cursor/underline, black ink. No yellow, beige, paper grain gloom, 3D, eyes added to the question hook, talking face mouth, punctuation mascots everywhere, window, screenshot, fake chat bubbles, cards, gradients, thought clouds, clutter. Precision optical composition; joyful, irreverent, and memorable through one character-origin illusion. A visitor should feel invited to ask for screen help immediately.

name: The line between you
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design an extraordinary finished homepage hero screenshot for Perry, a little hand-inked companion that helps operate a Mac. Landscape 1536x1024. This concept must be radically different from a giant cursor poster or notebook illustration. Dramatic graphic depth made from typography, simple ink, one tiny active character. No conventional headline-left/art-right division.
CONCEPT THE LINE BETWEEN YOU. The entire page is cut visually into two planes by ONE perfectly clean horizontal white hairline at mid-height. It is a seam in a black printed page, not a paper tear or physical fold. Enormous IVORY lowercase type spells 'you' across the upper half, in a soft, confident ultra-bold grotesk, almost full width. Enormous IVORY lowercase 'perry' occupies the lower half, edge-cropped deliberately on both sides like a gigantic stage. There is ample negative space inside the large letter counters. The two words are connected by one long CORAL hand-drawn line, travelling from a small regular white cursor inside the counter of the 'o' in YOU, down through the horizontal seam, and into the counter of the p in PERRY. Here is the extraordinary focal point: a tiny ivory outline Perry is physically leaning THROUGH the hairline from below, prying it open just locally with one hand while reaching up with the other to accept the cursor. This locally opened seam forms a small arch approximately 200px wide, and otherwise remains hairline-thin across the whole canvas. The page itself is behaving like a screen border. Character is a round unfilled head with TWO vertical oval eyes and NO mouth, thin ivory stick limbs; no fully rendered body beneath if occluded. It is intimate contact between the reader's layer and the helper's layer. Avoid a room, theatre props, shelves, lamps, or a diorama.
Palette deep matte charcoal-black and clear warm ivory, bright coral as the only colour. Exquisite clean high-contrast typography, very faint fine-grain ink in letterforms only. Upper left small simple 'perry'. Top right 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' and theme icon. The words YOU/PERRY are the monumental art. A stable unobtrusive ivory footer strip of 100px at bottom carries BLACK clean 23px exact copy 'Your Mac. An extra pair of hands.' and 17px 'Perry sees your screen, guides you, and helps do the work.' Right side black interaction button with white 'Meet halfway ↗' and small 'A website demo'. One tiny coral handwritten annotation beside the opened seam: 'pass it here.'
Carefully balance intimacy and monumental scale. Let the tiny handoff at the seam be the discovery that holds attention. The visual should feel like two worlds meeting across a screen, coherent mathematical letterforms, perfect kerning, character acting, and one impossible line. NO fake app UI, floating boxes, cards, hardware, physical books, gradient, neon, robot, overdrawn fingers, multiple characters, busy texture, explanatory diagram labels or poster mockup frame.

name: The cursor comet
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render ONE ambitious, original, beautifully crafted Perry website hero at 1536x1024 landscape. The user wants memorable visual invention paired with an invitation to use a Mac companion. They love huge living ink, mischievous stickman, optical wordplay and immersive typography. Make a fresh composition unlike SaaS, paper props or outlined app windows.
CONCEPT THE CURSOR COMET. A tiny familiar computer cursor leaves an enormous exquisite ribbon of handwritten ink in its wake, and Perry is riding the very end of the line, DRAWING THE WEBSITE AS YOU ARRIVE. The scene is a captured moment of one beautiful continuous gesture, not a fireworks effect. Background spotless warm-white. Across the entire viewport, from upper-left to lower-right, a spectacular BLACK calligraphic ribbon spells the exact word 'hello.' in gigantic distinctive brush script, about 600px high, with wild but elegant long ascenders and a wonderful open e and two rhythmic l's. The line then flows out of the final period into a large rising CORAL swoosh at the right edge. At its endpoint is a normal-shaped CORAL cursor arrow only 65px tall, pointed forward/up. Tiny black-ink stickman Perry, 140px tall, is standing with one foot on the side of the cursor and holding onto the flowing ink stroke as if windsurfing. His large round unfilled head with TWO vertical oval eyes, NO mouth, tilts toward the visitor; his free hand waves. The sweeping line bends under his weight with a slight dip. He is visibly authoring or guiding the stroke, never being dragged or harmed. Restrained little motion ticks only at his feet. The huge ink lettering and tiny moving cursor make a joyous extreme scale contrast.
The black word hello reverses to WHITE wherever it crosses one simple large black circle set partly OFF-CANVAS on left, creating an original geometric figure-ground counterweight. The black circle is completely flat screenprint, no orb or object, only 30 percent of circle visible, with half the initial h crossing it. Keep the lettering readable. The rest of page is open white, delightfully uncluttered. Sharp lithographic ink edge detail, microscopic texture, no heavy noise.
Tiny hand-lettered 'perry' upper-left on white. Upper-right 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' and sun/moon control. At bottom across a clean aligned baseline: left 30px black sans exact 'Your next click has company.' Beneath 18px 'Perry sees your screen, helps you learn, and can take on the task.' Right CORAL button with BLACK text 'Say hello to Perry ↗', small text 'Try him on this page'. One tiny handwritten note near the waving character reads 'coming with you.'
The image should have buoyant energy and sophisticated unmistakable letterforms, like a master calligrapher invented a living interface. This is a confident web hero with usable clear invitation, not a cartoon illustration on the right of text. NO app screenshots, laptop, window outlines, cards, feature grid, fake metrics, ink splatter everywhere, rainbow, sparks, stars, cosmic effects, glitter, glossy 3D, ruled notebooks, book spine, paper peel, generic script font. The distinctive story is ONE cursor painting ONE enormous greeting with ONE Perry riding at the tip.
